name: Vermont Electronics
old_description: Serving Stowe and Vermont since 1998 with over 48 years of technology experience!
about:
Founded in 1998 in Stowe, Vermont, Vermont Electronics began as a technology services firm serving the Stowe area and broader Vermont region. The company traces its roots to over 48 years of combined technology experience among its principals, though individual founders are not named in public materials.

The firm specializes in custom design and installation of integrated audio/video, home theater, smart home automation, lighting control, and security systems for both residential and commercial settings. Services encompass whole-house audio distribution, remote and mobile access for heating, security, and lighting, and coordination with new construction or renovation projects. The company operates from a post office box in Stowe and does not disclose facility size or headcount.

Vermont Electronics serves homeowners, builders, and commercial clients throughout Vermont. Its projects range from custom movie theater rooms and whole-house audio in private residences to smart automation and security installations in office environments. The company emphasizes collaboration with clients during new builds or remodels to embed technology seamlessly.

The company states its differentiation lies in excellence in planning, installation, technical knowledge, and customer service, backed by decades of cumulative technology experience. It positions itself as a local provider offering personalized digital lifestyle solutions rather than a product manufacturer.
